minutes.headline: Charter Review Committee approved two sets of minutes and discussed vacancy-filling rules, with no charter changes voted.
minutes.summary: The committee approved the August 8 and August 22 minutes (the latter as amended) and heard that guest speakers on candidate reporting and ranked choice voting will come at the next meeting. Most of the evening went to charter sections on filling vacancies, the 30-day appointing clock, the deputy moderator, and employees of elected boards. Town Counsel will be asked for language on several points, and members volunteered to write pro and con statements on the town clerk and select board terminology.

Chair will ask Town Counsel for proposed language on the second Town Meeting and whether it carries annual or special meeting requirements.

A future meeting portion will be devoted to employment issues, with the town manager and Town Counsel.
Chair will consult Town Counsel and the Board of Selectmen's policy on the vacancy clock and appointing authority.
Next meeting September 26; Town Counsel input on vacancy questions to be sought.

what_happened.line: The Charter Review Committee voted no charter changes; it spent most of the evening on how vacancies in town offices are filled.
The chair will ask Town Counsel about the vacancy clock, the appointing authority and the Board of Selectmen's policy, with no resolution reached.
The chair will also ask Town Counsel for language on a second Town Meeting and whether it carries annual or special meeting requirements.
Members agreed to write pro and con statements on the town clerk appointment and on select board versus selectmen wording.
The committee approved the August 8 and August 22 minutes, the latter as amended, and set the next meeting for September 26.

why_it_matters: The charter rules on who fills a vacancy, and how fast, decide how quickly an empty town seat is filled, and any change would go to voters as a charter question.
Nothing was decided, so the vacancy and second Town Meeting wording is still open and Town Counsel's advice will shape the draft.
watch_next: Next meeting September 26: guest speakers on candidate reporting and ranked choice voting, and Town Counsel input on the vacancy questions.
An updated draft of the Charter, to be circulated the week before the next meeting.
